visualCharacteristics.purpose: Accordion of study areas with plus-icon rows and ruled dividers; each panel holds grouped program link lists
visualCharacteristics.summary: Accordion of study areas with plus-icon rows and ruled dividers; each panel holds grouped program link lists

contentPattern.structure: One row per area. Cell 1: area name (e.g. Educación). Cell 2: H3 study-type subheadings, each followed by a list of program links (pretitle + title, linked). Missing cell 2 renders an empty panel
contentPattern.summary: One row per area. Cell 1: area name (e.g. Educación). Cell 2: H3 study-type subheadings, each followed by a list of program links (pretitle + title, linked). Missing cell 2 renders an empty panel

reuseGuidance: Use for long, grouped link directories that should stay collapsed; for FAQ-style text use a plain accordion.
